name: Hangzhou Diagens Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Diagens Biotechnology Co., Ltd., founded in 2016 and based in Hangzhou, is a medical device company developing medical imaging products and services. Its products include AI AutoVision, a chromosome karyotype analysis system, the MetaSight cell image scanning system and KayoFlow automated sample processing equipment for cytogenetics. It also provides reagents, consumables, localized AI computing solutions and the iMed MaaS cloud imaging AI platform.
